lead_intro: Delve into the mysterious and intriguing world of freshwater eels and their unique lifecycle. From hidden reproduction secrets to astonishing migrations, the story of eels is truly fascinating.

quiz.question: Where does the life of a freshwater eel actually begin?
quiz.explanation: The life of a freshwater eel actually begins in the salty waters of the Sargasso Sea.

quiz.question: How do eels transform into semi-transparent glass eels?
quiz.explanation: Eel larvae drift out of the Sargasso Sea and ride ocean currents to transform into glass eels.

quiz.question: At what stage do eels finally develop sexual organs?
quiz.explanation: Eels develop sexual organs at the yellow eel stage, after transforming from glass eels into elvers.

quiz.question: Where did Johannes Schmidt find the smallest eel larvae in 1921?
choices: Southern edge of the Sargasso Sea
quiz.answer: Southern edge of the Sargasso Sea
quiz.explanation: In 1921, Johannes Schmidt found the smallest eel larvae yet on the southern edge of the Sargasso Sea after an 18-year search.

quiz.question: What makes confirming the theory of eel reproduction difficult in the Sargasso Sea?
quiz.explanation: The powerful currents and tangling seaweed in the Sargasso Sea make confirming the theory of eel reproduction through external fertilization challenging.
